package.name: openarm_api
package.description: JSON gateway for the OpenArm skill layer. Translates a single, schema- validated JSON envelope (cmd_id / cmd_type / params) into ROS2 actions and services on top of openarm_skills, and re-broadcasts execution status back to the caller through ROS2 topics or an optional HTTP/WebSocket endpoint. Designed to be the only surface area an upper computer or LLM agent has to deal with.
